item.text: I’ll trace the call sound playback paths and existing tests, write the required checkpoint early, then make the smallest focused fix and run relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output; cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Investigating call sound playback and existing tests for the muted-audio issue. Next: locate call sound identifiers and playback entry points, implement unmute-before-play, then run relevant existing tests.
EOF
find src -iname '*Call*Sound*' -o -iname '*LegacyCallHandler*'; grep -RInE 'ringback|call-end|busy|ring' src/audio src/legacy src 2>/dev/null | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output; cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Investigating call sound playback and existing tests for the muted-audio issue. Next: locate call sound identifiers and playback entry points, implement unmute-before-play, then run relevant existing tests.
EOF
find src -iname '*Call*Sound*' -o -iname '*LegacyCallHandler*'; grep -RInE 'ringback|call-end|busy|ring' src/audio src/legacy src 2>/dev/null | head -120"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx; find src -path '*legacy*' -type f | head -60; cat package.json | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx; find src -path '*legacy*' -type f | head -60; cat package.json | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '390,435p' src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx; find src -path '*legacy*' -type f; grep -RIn 'LegacyCallHandler.play\\|handleEvent' src/legacy test 2>/dev/null | head"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '390,435p' src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx; find src -path '*legacy*' -type f; grep -RIn 'LegacyCallHandler.play\\|handleEvent' src/legacy test 2>/dev/null | head"
/bin/bash -lc "find test -type f | head; grep -RIn 'LegacyCallHandler' test | head -30; git diff -- src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md"
/bin/bash -lc "find test -type f | head; grep -RIn 'LegacyCallHandler' test | head -30; git diff -- src/LegacyCallHandler.tsx .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md"
